::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 4th [1897]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection[^1]
:::

Dear [Madam](people/person_2165.qmd)
As far as I can remember the first four tales were 
[Redclyffe](cmy_books/cmybook_15.qmd)
[Heartsease](cmy_books/cmybook_19.qmd)
[Hopes and Fears](cmy_books/cmybook_37.qmd)
[Dynevor Terrace](cmy_books/cmybook_27.qmd)	

because I meant them to have some sort of analogy to the four seasons[^2]

[The Daisy Chain](cmy_books/cmybook_24.qmd)
[Trial](cmy_books/cmybook_53.qmd)
are really connected, and the [Pillars of the House](cmy_books/cmybook_109.qmd) came later but picked up on [Countess Kate](cmy_books/cmybook_44.qmd) and the Daisy Chain in the course of the story -

[Scenes and Characters](cmy_books/cmybook_3.qmd) had been written long before, but was taken up again in [Two Sides of the Shield](cmy_books/cmybook_184.qmd)where also an early story [the Stokesley Secret](cmy_books/cmybook_40.qmd)furnished some characters -

[Beechcroft At Rockstone](cmy_books/cmybook_210.qmd)
[Strolling Players](cmy_books/cmybook_229.qmd)
[The Long Vacation](cmy_books/cmybook_237.qmd)
make up the story

The others are all disconnected except 
[The Chaplet of Pearls](cmy_books/cmybook_69.qmd)
[Stray Pearls](cmy_books/cmybook_170.qmd)
[The Release](cmy_books/cmybook_239.qmd) -

Some of the persons in [Magnum Bonum](cmy_books/cmybook_131.qmd) and Hopes and Fears are referred to again

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Envelope addressed to Mrs Wathen/ Withan House/ Alum Chine Road/ Bournemouth. Postmarked 97.
[^2]: This was on the analogy of La Motte Fouqué's *Die Jahrzeiten*.
